description: Laurel is the AI timekeeping and work intelligence platform built for professional services firms. This plugin brings that work into ChatGPT, so knowledge workers can review their day without leaving the conversation. Retrieve the time entries and activities Laurel captured throughout the day, and see where billable time went. Summarize work by client, matter, or application, and spot the gaps between what got done and what's been recorded. Turn that activity into billing narratives, ready for an end-of-day or weekly review. Access stays tied to your Laurel account throughout.
